author: reek
body: The bloom composite pass. Each pixel gathers the bright pixels around it -- a 40-tap golden-angle spiral read from the scene buffer through a storage-pointer helper parameter -- keeps only the part of each tap above a brightness threshold, and adds that glow to its own scene colour. Three passes of the fold (one per channel) give a coloured halo. This is the reference site's "bloom" technique as a two-pass compute post-process.

author: reek
body: Fold over the spiral taps: sample the scene buffer at each tap, take the amount of the chosen channel above the threshold, and sum. buf is a storage pointer.
